headline: Pawtucket teachers' union contract for 2026 through 2029, plus two letters about it.
summary: The agenda covers a labor contract between the Pawtucket School Committee and the Pawtucket Teachers' Alliance, Local 930, for September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2029. Also listed are two letters about the collective bargaining agreement.
items: Letter from William J. Conley, Jr., to Mark Wildenhain about the teachers' collective bargaining agreement
Letter from Scott F. Bielecki to Frank J. Milos, Jr., City Solicitor, about the teachers' collective bargaining agreement

AGENDA 
 
 
TO:  All Members of the Finance Committee 
  All Members of the Pawtucket City Council 
   
FROM:       Richard J. Goldstein, MMC, City Clerk 
 
DATE:          November 19, 2026 
 
SUBJECT: JOINT FINANCE COMMITTEE AND COMMITTEE OF THE WHOLE MEETING  
________________________________ 
 
You are requested to attend a joint meeting of the City Council Finance Committee an d the Committee 
of the Whole,  to be held on Tuesday, November 24, 2026 , at 6:15 p.m., at the Pawtucket Municipal 
Annex, 100 Freight Street , 1st Floor, City Council Conference Room - Room 140 , Pawtucket, Rhode 
Island. 
 
The purpose of this meeting is for discussion and/or consideration of the following: 
 
 
1. PUBLIC INPUT PERIOD Must Sign-in or Join via Zoom 10 minutes prior to meeting. 
 
2. Communication from William J. Conley, Jr., Conley Law & Associates, to the Honorable Mark 
Wildenhain, 2nd District City Council or (Collective Bargaining Agreement Between the Pawtucket 
School Committee and the Pawtucket Teachers Alliance, Local 930, AFT, AFL-CIO)  
 
3. Communication from Scott F. Bielecki, Cameron & Mittleman, LLP, to Frank J. Milos, Jr., Esq., 
City Solicitor (Collective Bargaining Agreement Between the Pawtucket School Committee and the 
Pawtucket Teachers Alliance, Local 930, AFT, AFL-CIO)  
 
4. Contract between the Pawtucket School Committee and the Pawtucket Teachers’ Alliance,  Local 
930, A.F.T., A.F.L.-C.I.O., for the period beginning September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2029 
 
 
This meeting is being called by Council President Terrence E. Mercer and Councilor Mark J. 
Wildenhain, Chair, Finance Committee.
